provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address data and actual copy excluded; vertical retained; copy structure only.

program_model.instance_model: flat-cut steel dimensional copy (room IDs, numbers, names) across types

knowledge.plain_language_summary: Flat-cut steel dimensional ID letters and numbers with mirror-polished faces and blackened returns (or the inverse), on a shim backer inset from the perimeter, with color-matched photopolymer raster braille tags. VHB-mounted; on glass a first-surface black vinyl backer hides the tape.
knowledge.rationale: Mirror-polished/blackened steel inversions give a premium finance-office finish; raster braille tags keep the dimensional copy ADA-compliant.

structure.construction: 1/4in (and 1/16in/1/8in) flat-cut steel, mirror-polished faces + blackened returns (or inverse), 1/16in shim backer inset 1/8in; returns sanded/polished smooth
photopolymer raster braille tags color-matched; full-coverage VHB foam (glass = first-surface black vinyl backer); 0-80x1in aluminum studs in silicone-filled holes for wall

compliance.notes: Grade-II photopolymer raster braille; tactile dimensional copy.

craft_observations: Mirror-polished vs blackened face/return inversions per sign type; returns polished after cutting = high finish discipline.
